secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret used to sign admin session tokens and user session JWTs. Any random string 32+ characters. A development placeholder is bundled; set a real value for production.

secrets.name: OAUTH_SERVER_URL
secrets.description: Manus OAuth server base URL. Optional — needed only for OAuth login flow.

secrets.name: VITE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Manus application ID used as OAuth clientId. Optional — needed only for OAuth login flow.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Forge API base URL for S3 storage proxy. Optional — needed only for file uploads.

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Forge API key for S3 storage proxy. Optional — needed only for file uploads.
